items.t: CUE touchscreen cracks, freezes or stops responding
items.job: Replace CUE touchscreen panel or display
items.note: Owners report $1,200-$1,550 at dealers; a touch layer alone is much cheaper.

items.t: Rear end sags or drops (leveling system)
items.job: Replace rear leveling shocks, air lines or compressor
items.note: CarComplaints owners report about $400 for minor repairs; one owner paid $2,400 for a compressor and shocks.

items.t: Rear shock absorbers leak or crack
items.job: Replace rear shock absorbers (pair)
items.note: CarComplaints lists about $1,600 for one 2015 repair.

items.t: Transmission shudder or harsh, slipping shifts
items.job: Replace valve body housings or repair transmission
items.note: CarComplaints lists about $2,400 for a shudder repair on a 2016.

items.t: Transmission cooler lines leak
items.job: Replace transmission cooler lines and top up fluid
items.note: One owner paid $1,900 including other work.

items.t: Wheel bearing hum or growl
items.job: Replace wheel hub bearing assembly

items.t: Sunroof binds, makes noise or leaks
items.job: Repair sunroof track, sunshade or drains
items.note: Owners report about $1,200-$1,400 for sunroof and sunshade repairs.

items.t: Battery drains and car will not start
items.job: Parasitic drain test and battery replacement

items.t: Battery drain from the memory seat module
items.job: Replace or reprogram memory seat module

items.t: Oil leak from the engine bedplate
items.job: Seal bedplate bolt per bulletin

items.t: Oil or coolant leak with the check engine light on
items.job: Replace leaking seals or gaskets per bulletin

items.t: Water on the front floor or musty smell
items.job: Find and seal water leak; dry carpet

items.t: Steering Assist Is Reduced message
items.job: Diagnose and repair electric power steering module or wiring

items.t: Cracked catalytic converter rattle or exhaust smell
items.job: Replace catalytic converter

items.t: Rear clunk over bumps from loose shock bolts
items.job: Re-torque rear shock bolts

items.t: A/C blows warm air
items.job: A/C diagnosis and repair

items.t: Keyless entry and push-button start not working
items.job: Diagnose keyless system and program or replace fob

items.t: Radio audio or warning chimes cut out
items.job: Free customer satisfaction program repair at a dealer
items.note: Covered by a GM program; ask a dealer with your VIN.

items.t: Engine stops after long idle in Park
items.job: Engine software update or bulletin repair

items.t: Engine knock or rattle
items.job: Engine inspection; repair or replace engine
items.note: Range runs from a minor fix to a full engine replacement.

items.t: Headlight or taillight condensation
items.job: Replace leaking lamp assembly

items.t: Brake booster pump connector can melt (recall)
items.job: Free recall repair at a Cadillac dealer

items.t: Electronic parking brake can stay partly applied (recall)
items.job: Free recall repair at a Cadillac dealer

items.t: Brake lights can flash when not braking (recall)
items.job: Free recall repair at a Cadillac dealer

items.t: Front head restraint may not stay in position (recall)
items.job: Free recall repair at a Cadillac dealer

items.t: Steering parts may come loose (recall)
items.job: Free recall repair at a Cadillac dealer

items.t: Side airbag inflator can rupture (recall)
items.job: Free recall repair at a Cadillac dealer

items.t: Rear brake caliper pistons may lack coating (recall)
items.job: Free recall repair at a Cadillac dealer

items.t: Seat belt buckle can separate in a crash (recall)
items.job: Free recall repair at a Cadillac dealer
